description: Use this when someone asks whether a mountain pass or the I-90 or SR 520 floating bridge is open, what the restrictions or chain rules are, or how long the crossing takes. Answers for Snoqualmie, Stevens, White and Blewett passes with WithBy's verdict for each direction and the crossing time against the usual, for the two bridges with their crossing times and alerts, and for 12 other passes with WSDOT's words; at Lake Tahoe, Donner Pass (I-80), Echo Summit (US 50), Carson Pass (SR 88) and SR 89 over Luther Pass and at Emerald Bay, from Caltrans's chain controls. Every answer carries the time WithBy checked and the agency's own report time. Not for navigation, bookings, or other roads and passes.

pass.description: The pass or bridge by name, e.g. "Snoqualmie Pass", "Stevens" or "SR 520 bridge"
